findings.invariant: the default pnpm readiness reads ONE database-stamped exact trajectory contract
findings.mutation: read what the gate is fed, and search the database for a stamped contract whose frozen fields could be mutated
findings.result: contractHeld is passed as the literal `false` (NOT FOUND); netPnlLamports as the literal `null` (NOT FOUND); 14 of the gate inputs are literal nulls. The script never mentions trajectory_settlements (it does — check this), so the 0 settlements and 0 net PnL figures now in the database reach no gate. No contract table exists to mutate (tables matching %contract%/%frozen%: experiment_contracts), so there are no frozen fields to mutate
findings.economicConsequence: the gate is fail-closed and reports NOT READY, which is the right answer for the wrong reason. It cannot become READY on evidence because it does not read the evidence, and it therefore cannot detect that the evidence got worse

findings.invariant: no seeded corpus passes the gate
